title: Reeb Cycles Teases Next-Generation Steel SST Prototype
content:
Reeb Cycles is introducing the next generation of its award-winning SST steel 120 mm trail bike, featuring a redesigned chassis, updated geometry and improved suspension kinematics. The prototype will make its debut at the 2026 Sedona Mountain Bike Festival, November 6–8, where riders and media can get a first look at the refined platform and meet the team behind the bike…

Reeb SST

First introduced in 2022, and reviewed here at The Radavist in 2023, the SST blends the playful, rowdy character of Reeb’s steel hardtails with the capability and performance of a modern full-suspension trail bike. The 120 mm flex-stay platform combines custom steel tubing, innovative 3D-printed stainless steel components and proprietary suspension technology to deliver a responsive, efficient ride that’s equally comfortable crushing climbs, slapping berms and getting rowdy on technical descents.

Building on that foundation, Reeb has evolved the SST prototype geometry to improve stability and confidence on technical descents while maintaining its efficient climbing performance and playful handling. At the heart of the next-generation SST prototype is an updated 120 mm flex-stay suspension platform featuring revised kinematics designed to improve small-bump sensitivity, pedaling efficiency and overall suspension performance. These updates also expand tuning possibilities, including improved compatibility with coil shocks.

Steel SST Prototype Updates

The SST’s steel chassis also received engineering updates, including an additive-manufactured rocker pivot housing and enlarged bottom bracket cluster for improved alignment and a more cohesive, integrated design. A new bridged rocker linkage with a collet system delivers smoother, more consistent suspension performance, while redesigned hardware simplifies routine maintenance and makes the SST more approachable for riders who prefer turning their own wrenches. The rocker and suspension hardware are manufactured by Prosise Metal Works, led by longtime Reeb collaborator Adam Prosise.

Designed by the Reeb team and fabricated in-house in Longmont, Colorado, the next-generation SST prototype continues Reeb’s commitment to handmade steel frames, innovative engineering and building bikes that are as fun to ride as they are to look at. Reeb’s fabrication operations are now based at Hooptie Bike Lounge, bringing frame building, a full-service bike shop and a craft beer bar together under one roof.

Where To See It

Visit the Reeb Cycles booth at Sedona Mountain Bike Festival, November 6–8, to see the next-generation SST prototype, meet Jeff Lenosky and the Reeb team, and learn more about the bike’s development. Media are invited to stop by for interviews, prototype photography and a closer look at the new chassis, rocker and suspension hardware.

The next-generation SST is currently in development for 2027, sign up for updates with additional specifications, pricing and availability details at Reeb.
